value.rationale: A motivated rank-trimming stability criterion in nonlinear cyclic smoothing: deleting any one order statistic preserves two-input BV nonexpansivity at every width, unlike median and the natural two-deletion trimmed mean. The transport factorization is reusable, the three-point midrange dimension classification is exact, and the large-cycle constant is sharp.
